rationale.conceptual: The method is standard DFT with the PBE functional and DNP basis set; spin-unrestricted and all-electron relativistic settings are typical. No novel algorithms are required, but correct implementation of formulas and careful choice of settings are needed.
rationale.execution: Multi-stage pipeline involving geometry preparation, reference atom calculations, 31 DFT optimizations, and post-processing to CSV. Orchestrating many independent runs and correctly extracting values requires a moderately complex workflow, though each step is straightforward.

difficulty.reasoning: Reproducing standard DFT calculations for a series of small clusters; moderate conceptual understanding of DFT settings and execution orchestration for many runs.

compute_estimate.reasoning: 31 B36 and TMB36 clusters of ~37 atoms each; DFT PBE/DNP calculations are CPU-only, moderate memory per job (a few GB), and input data are tiny coordinate sets.
